rows.label: MARKING

rows.label: DIALECT

rows.label: SPORTS PAGE

rows.label: PART MUSIC

rows.label: VOICE OVER

rows.label: FREE FORM
rows.clue: A morpheme that can occur alone

rows.label: SCHERZO

rows.label: TELEPATHY
rows.clue: Apparent communication from one mind to another without using sensory perceptions

rows.label: DISCLAIMER

rows.label: PERCENT SIGN

rows.label: EXPLANATION
rows.clue: A statement that makes something comprehensible by describing the relevant structure or operation or circumstances etc.

rows.label: VERBAL NOUN
rows.clue: A noun that is derived from a verb

rows.label: WHITE LIE
rows.clue: An unimportant lie (especially one told to be tactful or polite)

rows.label: BULL SESSION
rows.clue: An informal discussion (usually among men)

rows.label: IAMBIC
rows.clue: A verse line consisting of iambs

rows.label: QUIZ PROGRAM
rows.clue: A game show in which contestants answer questions

rows.label: AIR LETTER
rows.clue: A letter sent by air mail

rows.label: ASSEMBLER
rows.clue: A program to convert assembly language into machine language

rows.label: STRESS MARK
rows.clue: A mark indicating the stress on a syllable

rows.label: SCRAWL

rows.label: WORD SALAD

rows.label: AIR MAIL
rows.clue: Mail that is sent by air transport

rows.label: PARTY LINE

rows.label: DEED

rows.label: VOWEL POINT

rows.label: WORK SONG
rows.clue: A usually rhythmical song to accompany repetitious work

rows.label: SQUIGGLE
rows.clue: A short twisting line

rows.label: VALEDICTORY

rows.label: CROSSWORD

rows.label: COLLAGE FILM

rows.label: YARN

rows.label: IDENTIFIER
rows.clue: A symbol that establishes the identity of the one bearing it

rows.label: SIGN MANUAL

rows.label: BARGAIN
rows.clue: An agreement between parties (usually arrived at after discussion) fixing obligations of each

rows.label: ANNOTATION
rows.clue: A comment or instruction (usually added)

rows.label: PROMPT COPY
rows.clue: The copy of the playscript used by the prompter

rows.label: KENNING
rows.clue: Conventional metaphoric name for something, used especially in Old English and Old Norse poetry

rows.label: FAREWELL
rows.clue: An acknowledgment or expression of goodwill at parting

rows.label: SEMIMONTHLY

rows.label: GROUND BASS

rows.label: SUBSTANTIVE

rows.label: STOCK SYMBOL

rows.label: MODULATION

rows.label: PILOT FILM
rows.clue: A program exemplifying a contemplated series

rows.label: OVERTONE

rows.label: PROFFER

rows.label: MAIL SERVICE
rows.clue: The system whereby messages are transmitted via the post office

rows.label: GUFF

rows.label: INVITE
rows.clue: A colloquial expression for invitation

rows.label: CANCEL
rows.clue: A notation cancelling a previous sharp or flat

rows.label: BAR EXAM
rows.clue: An examination conducted at regular intervals to determine whether a candidate is qualified to practice law in a given jurisdiction

rows.label: PROMPT
rows.clue: A cue given to a performer (usually the beginning of the next line to be spoken)

rows.label: ACCENT MARK
rows.clue: A diacritical mark used to indicate stress or placed above a vowel to indicate a special pronunciation

rows.label: WATCH FIRE
rows.clue: A fire lighted at night as a signal

rows.label: LABEL
rows.clue: A brief description given for purposes of identification

rows.label: QUIBBLE
rows.clue: An evasion of the point of an argument by raising irrelevant distinctions or objections

rows.label: MACRON
rows.clue: A diacritical mark (-) placed above a vowel to indicate a long sound

rows.label: TELECAST
rows.clue: A television broadcast

rows.label: TONALITY
rows.clue: Any of 24 major or minor diatonic scales that provide the tonal framework for a piece of music

rows.label: CHAT ROOM
rows.clue: A site on the internet where a number of users can communicate in real time (typically one dedicated to a particular topic)

rows.label: VERB PHRASE
rows.clue: One of the two main constituents of a sentence

rows.label: ROUNDELAY
rows.clue: A song in which a line or phrase is repeated as the refrain

rows.label: TIME SIGNAL
rows.clue: A signal (especially electronic or by radio) indicating the precisely correct time

rows.label: BEHEST
rows.clue: An authoritative command or request

rows.label: SUITE
rows.clue: A musical composition of several movements only loosely connected

rows.label: EPITAPH
rows.clue: An inscription on a tombstone or monument in memory of the person buried there

rows.label: DOLLAR MARK
rows.clue: A symbol of commercialism or greed

rows.label: OUTBURST
rows.clue: An unrestrained expression of emotion

rows.label: VIRGULE
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (/) used to separate related items of information

rows.label: ABRACADABRA
rows.clue: Gibberish and nonsense

rows.label: SPARRING
rows.clue: An argument in which the participants are trying to gain some advantage

rows.label: DIRECTIVE
rows.clue: A pronouncement encouraging or banning some activity

rows.label: SUBPOENA
rows.clue: A writ issued by court authority to compel the attendance of a witness at a judicial proceeding

rows.label: SHOP TALK
rows.clue: Talk about your business that only others in the same business can understand

rows.label: TONE
rows.clue: The quality of a person's voice

rows.label: ACRONYM
rows.clue: A word formed from the initial letters of the several words in the name

rows.label: PRINTOUT
rows.clue: The output of a computer in printed form

rows.label: RADIOGRAM
rows.clue: A message transmitted by wireless telegraphy

rows.label: DEBRIEFING
rows.clue: Report of a mission or task

rows.label: HONOR
rows.clue: A tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction

rows.label: PRIMER
rows.clue: An introductory textbook

rows.label: FULL POINT
rows.clue: A punctuation mark (.) placed at the end of a declarative sentence to indicate a full stop or after abbreviations

rows.label: CONTENT WORD
rows.clue: A word to which an independent meaning can be assigned

rows.label: DEMUR
rows.clue: (law) a formal objection to an opponent's pleadings

rows.label: BOOK REVIEW
rows.clue: A critical review of a book (usually a recently published book)

rows.label: RAGTIME
rows.clue: Music with a syncopated melody (usually for the piano)

rows.label: FONT
rows.clue: A specific size and style of type within a type family

rows.label: PLAY
rows.clue: A dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage

rows.label: FEATURE FILM
rows.clue: The principal (full-length) film in a program at a movie theater

rows.label: SPEECH ACT
rows.clue: The use of language to perform some act

rows.label: ANAPEST
rows.clue: A metrical unit with unstressed-unstressed-stressed syllables

rows.label: MANTLE
rows.clue: The cloak as a symbol of authority

rows.label: ACCORDANCE
rows.clue: Concurrence of opinion

rows.label: CAN BUOY
rows.clue: A buoy with a round bottom and conical top
